alamariyañāṇadassana.p: [Alaṃ+ariya+ñāṇa+dassana] (ti) CL=5 Possessing the ability to destroy lust - pure - noble - intelligent. See also Alamariya Wisdom Philosophy.
a: အလမရိယဉာဏဒဿန(တိ)
[အလံ+အရိယ+ဉာဏ+ဒဿန]
ကိလေသာကို ဖျက်ဆီးခြင်း၌ စွမ်းနိုင်သော-စင်ကြယ်သော-မြတ်သော-ဉာဏ ္အမြင်ရှိသော။ အလမရိယဉာဏဒဿနဝိသေသ-လည်းကြည့်။

alamariyañāṇadassanavisesa.p: [(1)alamariya+ñāṇadassanavisesa.(2)alamariyañāṇadassana+visesa] (pu) CL=5 (1) The Dhamma that is suitable for the noble ones, which can make the state of the noble one special, and (2) The Dhamma that is capable of destroying the senses, the pure Dhamma that is capable of destroying the passions.
a: အလမရိယဉာဏဒဿနဝိသေသ(ပု)
[(၁)အလမရိယ+ဉာဏဒဿနဝိသေသ။(၂)အလမရိယဉာဏဒဿန+ဝိသေသ]
